command: torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node ${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1} -m voxtoken.runner.train_policy_torch --config voxtoken/configs/train_policy_radgenome_lung_nodule_oracle_torch_e0951_seed0.yaml && torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node ${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1} -m voxtoken.runner.train_policy_torch --config voxtoken/configs/train_policy_radgenome_lung_nodule_oracle_torch_e0951_seed1.yaml && torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node ${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1} -m voxtoken.runner.train_policy_torch --config voxtoken/configs/train_policy_radgenome_lung_nodule_oracle_torch_e0951_seed2.yaml && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_policy_checkpoint --in outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed0/checkpoint.json --require-nondefault-weights && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_policy_checkpoint --in outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed1/checkpoint.json --require-nondefault-weights && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_policy_checkpoint --in outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed2/checkpoint.json --require-nondefault-weights

command: python -m voxtoken.runner.ct_rate_grounding_benchmark --manifest artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_full_eligible_e0949/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed0 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --budgets 8 16 32 --max-cases 0 --split val --seed 0 --policy-ckpt outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed0/checkpoint.json && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_grounding_benchmark --in artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed0/summary.json --require-methods fixed heuristic learned random oracle && python -m voxtoken.runner.ct_rate_grounding_benchmark --manifest artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_full_eligible_e0949/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed1 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --budgets 8 16 32 --max-cases 0 --split val --seed 1 --policy-ckpt outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed1/checkpoint.json && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_grounding_benchmark --in artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed1/summary.json --require-methods fixed heuristic learned random oracle && python -m voxtoken.runner.ct_rate_grounding_benchmark --manifest artifacts/radgenome_gt_lung_nodule_full_eligible_e0949/manifest.jsonl --out artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed2 --config voxtoken/configs/ct_rate_ts_grounding_e0907.yaml --budgets 8 16 32 --max-cases 0 --split val --seed 2 --policy-ckpt outputs/train_policy/E0951_seed2/checkpoint.json && python -m voxtoken.runner.validate_grounding_benchmark --in artifacts/e0952_benchmark_radgenome_lung_nodule_full_eligible_seed2/summary.json --require-methods fixed heuristic learned random oracle
